mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces risk-free rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1705 and RSAFS < 630000 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5, FEDFUNDS < 0.5, and INDPRO < 100.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1700 units signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1700 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 282.0 in the last month signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a tightening of monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 282.0 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals a policy response to economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing amid labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and UNRATE > 4.0 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (defined by PAYEMS > 149000 and UNRATE < 4.2%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals improving labor conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 149000 and UNRATE < 4.0 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
